title: Entry key bowl
prompt: A shallow entryway key bowl, 140 mm diameter, smooth lofted profile from a 90 mm flat base, 2.8 mm walls, interior fillets so contents slide to center.
lesson: Entry key bowl — farmed pattern for "bowl"-class prompts. Judge 89/100.
code:
from build123d import *

# ---- Shallow entryway key bowl ----
outer_d = 140.0          # rim outer diameter
base_d = 90.0            # flat base diameter
wall = 2.8               # wall thickness
bowl_h = 34.0            # overall height
base_chamfer = 1.0       # build-plate edge break
rim_r = wall * 0.4       # rim edge softening
interior_r = wall * 0.9  # interior corner fillet (contents slide to center)
reveal = 1.5             # recessed base reveal

outer_top_r = outer_d / 2
base_top_r = base_d / 2

# base is inset for a recessed reveal foot
foot_r = base_top_r
inner_base_r = base_d / 2 - wall

# ---- outer lofted shell profile ----
with BuildPart() as bowl:
    # footprint plinth (small reveal ring)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(0)):
        Circle(foot_r)
    # lofted bowl body: narrow flat base flaring to wide rim
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(reveal)):
        Circle(base_top_r + 3)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(bowl_h)):
        Circle(outer_top_r)
    loft()

    # hollow interior via loft cut ---------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(reveal + wall)):
        Circle(inner_base_r)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(bowl_h + 1)):
        Circle(outer_top_r - wall)
    loft(mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # rim edge softening (top exposed edges)
    top_edges = bowl.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    fillet(top_edges, rim_r)

    # base edge break (build-plate)
    bottom_edges = bowl.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).group_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    chamfer(bottom_edges, base_chamfer)

    # interior floor fillet so contents slide to center
    floor_face = bowl.faces().filter_by(Plane.XY).sort_by(Axis.Z)
    inner_floor_edges = (
        bowl.edges()
        .filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
        .group_by(Axis.Z)[1]
    )
    fillet(inner_floor_edges, interior_r)

result = bowl.part
